children: RNS Number : 2757V  Galileo Resources PLC  18 September 2026
Update on Sale of 2 Kalahari Copper Belt Licences for US$3 million

Galileo Resources plc (" Galileo “or the "Company") is pleased to announce that all the conditions precedent have been met in relation to its conditional share purchase agreement entered into on 15 June 2026 with Metal Capital Exploration Limited (“Metal Capital”), a wholly owned subsidiary of ASX-listed Sandfire Resources Limited (Sandfire), with Sandfire acting as purchaser guarantor.
Accordingly, Completion of the share purchase agreement (as defined in the 16 June RNS) is anticipated to occur on or around 30 September 2026.
You can also follow Galileo on Twitter: GalileoResource
For further information, please contact: Galileo Resources PLC
Shard Capital Partners LLP – Joint Broker
